confidence.rationale: The affected baseline contains 10 flagged records, and all 69 records reconcile exactly once: 6 artifacts, 4 exact-match allergen mismatches, 57 exact matches with allergens accurately unavailable, 1 normalized match accurately unavailable, and 1 variant match accurately unavailable. Re-opened restaurant-issued menus confirm the extraction artifacts and cross-contact warning, while the Alexandria Toast ordering surface directly confirms omitted allergen labels on four baseline items.

confirmedFindings: Reconciliation covers all 69 baseline records exactly once: 6 artifact/not_applicable, 4 exact_match/mismatch, 57 exact_match/accurately_unavailable, 1 normalized_match/accurately_unavailable, and 1 variant_match/accurately_unavailable.
Six baseline records are headings, continuation text, or configuration text rather than independently orderable items.
The Alexandria Toast menu labels Cheese Fries, Fried Mozzarella, and Steak & Cheese Eggrolls with gluten and dairy, while their baseline arrays omit gluten.
The Alexandria Toast menu labels Tuna Tartar with gluten, dairy, nut, and fish; the baseline includes gluten, fish, and tree-nut but omits dairy.

The Alexandria restaurant-issued menu states that Augie's is not a gluten-free kitchen and asks guests to notify their server of allergies; this is a cross-contact warning rather than a complete allergen matrix.
rejectedFindings: Toast's omission of egg from Steak & Cheese Eggrolls and Tuna Tartar does not, by itself, prove that egg is absent; the defensible discrepancies are the affirmative vendor-disclosed allergens missing from the baseline.
The partial Toast labels cannot validate or invalidate allergen claims for the remaining 65 menu items, and neither restaurant-issued menu supplies a complete allergen matrix.

The active ordering page identifies the Alexandria location at 1106 King Street and affirmatively lists gluten/dairy for Cheese Fries, Fried Mozzarella, and Steak & Cheese Eggrolls, plus gluten/dairy/nut/fish for Tuna Tartar.

summary: Ten affected baseline records and all reconciliation counts were reviewed first.
